Day trips

  • A Day at Ouzoud Waterfalls

    About 11–12 hours · 08:30–19:00/20:00 · Marrakech → Marrakech

    Follow shaded paths through olive groves, pause above the cascades and enjoy lunch with the sound of falling water. A full day in the countryside from Marrakech, with transport arranged for you and your companions.

  • A Day in the Ourika Valley

    About 8–9 hours · 09:00–17:00/18:00 · Marrakech → Marrakech

    Walnut trees, hillside villages and lunch beside the river. Leave Marrakech for the Ourika Valley, with a waterfall walk at Setti Fatma or a quieter afternoon by the water.

  • Essaouira, a Day by the Sea

    About 11–12 hours · 08:30–19:00/20:00 · Marrakech → Marrakech

    Blue fishing boats, sea-facing ramparts and a medina made for wandering. Spend a day on the Atlantic coast, with time for a seafood lunch and a walk along the shore.
